name: Tailscale
verdict_reason: For individuals, Tailscale's free tier IS the product — 100 devices, 3 users, $0. Headscale is a superb control-plane replacement, but you'd be self-hosting to avoid a bill that doesn't exist. It earns its place only when team pricing or compliance says the coordination server must be yours.
what_you_lose: Tailscale's DERP relay fleet — your headscale needs its own relays or direct connectivity
MagicDNS/SSO polish and their security team watching the control plane
